<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by fractional values. It generates a clock signal with a fractional frequency division (3.5x), using the double-edge clocking technique to achieve half-integer division while adjusting for duty cycle imbalance. By dividing uneven clock cycles and phase-shifting them, a smooth fractional clock output is produced.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Fractionally divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="MUL2_DIV_CLK">Number of clock cycles for fractional division.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt">Counter for fractional division.</reg>
        <reg id="clk_div_int">Intermediate divided clock signal.</reg>
        <reg id="phase_clk">Phase-adjusted clock signal.</reg>
        <reg id="half_phase_clk">Half-phase adjusted clock signal.</reg>
        <wire id="next_cnt">Next value of the counter.</wire>
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)>
            if (~rst_n)
                cnt <= 0;
            else
                cnt <= next_cnt;
        end
        <assign next_cnt = (cnt == MUL2_DIV_CLK - 1) ? 0 : cnt + 1;
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)>
            if (~rst_n)
                clk_div_int <= 0;
            else begin
                case(cnt)
                    0, 1, 2, 3: clk_div_int <= 1;
                    default: clk_div_int <= 0;
                endcase
            end
        end
        <always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n)>
            if (~rst_n)
                phase_clk <= 0;
            else begin
                case(cnt)
                    0, 1, 2, 3: phase_clk <= 1;
                    default: phase_clk <= 0;
                endcase
            end
        end
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)>
            if (~rst_n)
                half_phase_clk <= 0;
            else begin
                case(cnt)
                    0, 1, 2, 3: half_phase_clk <= 0;
                    default: half_phase_clk <= 1;
                endcase
            end
        end
        <assign clk_div = clk_div_int | phase_clk | half_phase_clk;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Double edge clocking technique to divide the input clock by 3.5x. Uses a counter to keep track of the number of clock cycles. Generates two uneven clock periods: one with 4 source clock cycles and another with 3 source clock cycles. In the next cycle, phase-shifted versions of the divided clock are generated. One phase is delayed by half a clock period, and the other is advanced by half a clock period. Finally, the two intermediate clocks are logically OR-ed to produce the final fractional divided clock output, ensuring the divided clock signal has a uniform period.</implementation>
</module>
